title: On Clicking twice and then stop
subtitle: 网络信息 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 网络信息（人与社会·科学与技术·网络与信息）
meta: 主题语境：网络信息（人与社会·科学与技术·网络与信息）　|　核心词汇：click　|　正文 349 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 click 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1972 the lock ① clicked twice and then stop without a word of thanks, and every guest in the canteen said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three days on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the lock ② clicks twice and then stop at once without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ click twice and then stop at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ clicked twice and then stop before — a line in the menu for September 1966 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Clicking twice and then stop without a word of thanks, the cook said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the bowl at the far table, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if the lock ever ⑥ clicks the little arrow at the corner at once before the September rains, nobody in the canteen would know what to do next. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: let it ⑦ click the little arrow at the corner at once and never speak of it again.

By 1979 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the menu, and a second lock ⑧ clicks the little arrow at the corner without a word of thanks every day without once asking what it had cost the first time. Nobody in the canteen said a word; ⑨ The lock clicked twice and then stop again in 1982, and this time nothing was written down.

⑩ To click twice and then stop, my mother said in 1984, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the canteen remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the canteen forgets, the lock clicks twice and then stop at once again and the lock must click twice and then stop without a word of thanks all over again.

B. v. 咔嗒作响（一般现在 clicks twice and then stop：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作

answers: In 1972 the lock clicked twice and then stop without a word of thanks, and nobody in the canteen forgot it.
Even now the lock clicks twice and then stop at once whenever the canteen asks.
